trixi-studios--spiders-6d-ai.description_zh: Chip Sineni 为 6D.ai SDK 做的一个令人发毛的测试：借助房间的实时网格，蜘蛛在真实家具上爬行，还会躲到家具后面。
trixi-studios--spiders-6d-ai.idea_en: Let virtual spiders crawl along real furniture and hide behind it.
trixi-studios--spiders-6d-ai.technique_zh: 6D.ai 在手机上实时构建环境网格，既用于遮挡，也作为导航表面，让生物在真实几何上爬行。
trixi-studios--spiders-6d-ai.exercise_en: Use a LiDAR phone and AR Foundation Meshing to make a swarm of virtual bugs crawl over tables and chairs and get occluded. Twist: when the lights come on (ambient light gets brighter), they scatter and flee.

morten-just--stenciling-ar.description_zh: 通过手机把参考图“投”到纸上，让你用手照着描，立刻拥有画画的本事。
morten-just--stenciling-ar.idea_en: Cast a reference image onto paper so anyone can trace a good drawing.
morten-just--stenciling-ar.technique_zh: 把半透明的参考图锚定在纸张所在的平面上（通过平面检测或图像追踪），用户手绘描摹时它始终保持对齐。
morten-just--stenciling-ar.exercise_en: Use plane detection to fix a semi-transparent line drawing onto a sheet of white paper on the desk, and trace it. Twist: show the line drawing in steps, outline first, then details.

abhishek-singh--street-fighter-ii-ar.description_zh: 《街头霸王 II》的多人 AR 重制版：两名玩家用手机操控真人大小的格斗家，在真实的街道上对战。
abhishek-singh--street-fighter-ii-ar.idea_en: Turn Street Fighter into a two-player, life-size AR fight that actually takes to the streets.
abhishek-singh--street-fighter-ii-ar.technique_zh: 两部手机共享同一个 AR 坐标空间（大概率通过 ARKit 协作会话，或共享锚点加网络同步），双方看到同样的真人大小格斗家，其操作输入通过网络同步。
abhishek-singh--street-fighter-ii-ar.exercise_en: Use Unity Netcode and AR Foundation so two phones share one anchor and each controls a block character trying to push the other out of a ring. Twist: attack with real body movements (shaking the phone) instead of buttons.

theo-triantafyllidis--studio-visit-porta.description_zh: 一件因地制宜的混合现实装置：一扇手机 AR 传送门从画廊通往艺术家工作室的一个超现实虚拟版本。
theo-triantafyllidis--studio-visit-porta.idea_en: A phone AR portal leads into the artist's bizarre studio.
theo-triantafyllidis--studio-visit-porta.technique_zh: AR 传送门在门洞平面上使用模板缓冲遮罩，使虚拟工作室只能透过门洞看到，整个场景与画廊墙面配准。
theo-triantafyllidis--studio-visit-porta.exercise_en: Use a stencil shader in Unity AR to build a portal that leads to an exaggerated fictional version of your desk. Twist: let a few objects 'leak' out of the world behind the door onto the real side.

apple--swiftshot.description_zh: WWDC 上发布的一款 ARKit 2 多人游戏：玩家用多部 iPhone/iPad 看到同一个桌面战场，互相用弹弓发射弹丸，攻击对方的木块。
apple--swiftshot.idea_en: A shared AR slingshot battle between several players at the same table.
apple--swiftshot.technique_zh: 在设备之间共享 ARWorldMap，让所有玩家重定位到相同的锚点，再通过点对点网络同步物理状态。
apple--swiftshot.exercise_en: Build a two-player battle with shared anchors in Reality Composer or AR Foundation: on the same tabletop, flick the phone to launch balls and knock down the opponent's blocks. Twist: a real cup on the table acts as a solid obstacle.

tender-claws--tendar.description_zh: 一款 ARCore 宠物游戏：一条会说话的孔雀鱼住在相机画面里，靠读取玩家面部表情得到的情绪为食，还会让玩家把周围的物品拿给它看。
tender-claws--tendar.idea_en: A small AR fish that feeds on your expressions and emotions.
tender-claws--tendar.technique_zh: 前置摄像头的面部表情分类决定宠物的情绪状态，后置摄像头的物体识别则检查玩家是否展示了它要求的物品。
tender-claws--tendar.exercise_en: Use expression recognition (MediaPipe or ARKit blend shapes) to tell whether you are smiling, and have an AR fish feed on your emotions. Twist: the fish asks you to photograph a specific object and checks it with object recognition.

abhishek-singh--the-ring-ar.description_zh: 重现那个著名的恐怖场景：贞子从电视里爬出来进入客厅，而这一切锚定在一台真实的电视上。
abhishek-singh--the-ring-ar.idea_en: Make Sadako from The Ring really crawl out of the TV at home.
abhishek-singh--the-ring-ar.technique_zh: 把绑定好骨骼的角色动画与真实电视对齐（大概率通过手动放置或对屏幕做图像追踪），并在电视边框上加遮挡蒙版，使人物看起来是从屏幕里钻出来的。
abhishek-singh--the-ring-ar.exercise_en: Use image tracking to recognize a picture on a laptop screen and have a character 'crawl out' of the screen onto the desk, with an occlusion material on the screen bezel hiding the part still inside. Twist: make something emerge from a fridge door or a drawer instead.

nathan-gitter--time-travel-graffiti.description_zh: 在一座墙面每天都在变化的公共涂鸦公园里，手机会在原位显示作品早先的版本，让你看见过去。
nathan-gitter--time-travel-graffiti.idea_en: In front of a graffiti wall painted over every day, use AR to see what it used to look like.
nathan-gitter--time-travel-graffiti.technique_zh: 通过图像识别追踪各段墙面（大概率以早先的照片为比对基准），再把过去涂鸦的存档照片叠加在检测到的图像位姿上。
nathan-gitter--time-travel-graffiti.exercise_en: Photograph a campus wall as it looks today to use as the recognition image, then overlay old photos when it is scanned later, with a slider to switch between dates. Twist: let classmates leave graffiti on the wall that can only be seen in AR.

sigur-ros--tonandi.description_zh: 一个可交互的 Magic Leap 声音景观：发光的声音生物遍布你真实的房间，用手触碰、聚拢它们或朝它们挥手，就能叠加并塑造 Sigur Rós 的音乐。
sigur-ros--tonandi.idea_en: Reach out and touch glowing creatures in your room to play and shape the music.
sigur-ros--tonandi.technique_zh: 锚定在房间中的生物智能体各自携带一段音乐分轨或采样，手部追踪检测到的接触或接近会触发、叠加并调制这些音源。
sigur-ros--tonandi.exercise_en: Scatter five glowing AR creatures around a room, each tied to a music stem that fades in as you approach. Twist: when they are gathered together, the stems combine into a complete piece.

matthew-hallberg--valve-portal-arkit.description_zh: 利用 ARKit 1.5 的竖直平面检测，在真实墙面上发射一对相连的蓝色和橙色传送门，并能透过它们看到另一侧。
matthew-hallberg--valve-portal-arkit.idea_en: Shoot the blue and orange portals from Portal onto real walls.
matthew-hallberg--valve-portal-arkit.technique_zh: 放置在检测到的竖直平面上的传送门使用来自成对虚拟相机的渲染纹理，每台相机的位姿复刻观者相对于另一扇传送门的位姿。
matthew-hallberg--valve-portal-arkit.exercise_en: Place a portal on each of two walls, each showing the RenderTexture of a virtual camera behind the other portal, and send a virtual ball in one portal and out the other. Twist: each side of the portal has a different time of day (day on one side, night on the other).

ishikawa-watanabe-lab--variolight.description_zh: 一套由反射镜导向的高速投影系统，能在整个舞台上追踪舞者，并把影像投射到他们身上而不发生漂移。
ishikawa-watanabe-lab--variolight.idea_en: High-speed steering mirrors chase a dancer across the stage, landing images precisely on a moving body.
ishikawa-watanabe-lab--variolight.technique_zh: 两面振镜在高速视觉追踪器的驱动下高速引导投影光束，使一个小投影区域能在大舞台上跟随移动的表演者。
ishikawa-watanabe-lab--variolight.exercise_en: Mount a projector on a servo pan-tilt head (or just move a projected spot within the frame), track a running classmate with a camera, and keep a pattern on them at all times. Twist: the dancer's movement switches the spot's target (raising a hand sends it to another person).

refik-anadol--wdch-dreams.description_zh: 为庆祝洛杉矶爱乐乐团百年，这件作品用机器学习处理了乐团 45 TB 的档案，并将其作为这座建筑的“梦境”投影在华特·迪士尼音乐厅的外墙上。
refik-anadol--wdch-dreams.idea_en: Let a concert hall use AI to 'dream' its hundred years of memories and project them onto its facade.
refik-anadol--wdch-dreams.technique_zh: 机器学习模型对档案图像和音频进行聚类与形变，结果通过 42 台投影机映射到 Gehry 设计的弧形不锈钢立面上。
refik-anadol--wdch-dreams.exercise_en: Collect old school photos, generate a sequence with simple image clustering or style blending, and project it onto a campus wall. Twist: let passers-by vote on their phones for the theme of the next 'dream'.

jerome-etienne--webxr-studio-augmented-w.description_zh: 一款浏览器端创作工具，让任何人都能拼装 AR 场景，并发布成可在任意手机上观看的“增强网站”。
jerome-etienne--webxr-studio-augmented-w.idea_en: Assemble AR scenes in the browser and publish them straight to an 'augmented website'.
jerome-etienne--webxr-studio-augmented-w.technique_zh: 浏览器编辑器把由 3D 素材和锚点设置组成的场景图序列化为一个 URL，WebXR/AR.js 查看器在任意手机上加载这份描述。
jerome-etienne--webxr-studio-augmented-w.exercise_en: Build a simple editor page with A-Frame that generates a share link after you drag three objects into place, so anyone opening the link sees the same layout in AR. Twist: let visitors add an object too, so the scene keeps growing.

zach-lieberman--weird-type.description_zh: 一款 iOS AR 应用，用动态字体在 3D 空间中书写和绘画；文字可以沿着你走过的路径排布、对声音做出反应、炸开，还可以绕着它走动观看。
zach-lieberman--weird-type.idea_en: Use letters as a brush to write in real space, walk around them and warp them with sound.
zach-lieberman--weird-type.technique_zh: ARKit 相机位姿提供一条 3D 路径，字形轮廓沿路径排布，字形顶点则由逐帧噪声、时间和麦克风音量驱动动画。
zach-lieberman--weird-type.exercise_en: In three.js WebXR or Unity, place the letters of a sentence one by one in space along the phone's path, and make them shake or burst with microphone volume. Twist: choose a sentence that only reads correctly if you walk backward from a particular spot.

abhishek-singh--wile-e-coyote-ar.description_zh: Looney Tunes 的角色在真实房间里互相追逐，威利狼的卡通陷阱就设在真实的家具旁边。
abhishek-singh--wile-e-coyote-ar.idea_en: Stage the cartoon chase between Wile E. Coyote and the Road Runner in a real room.
abhishek-singh--wile-e-coyote-ar.technique_zh: 角色沿着布置在检测到的地面平面上的脚本路径移动，遮挡几何体大致与真实家具吻合，让角色可以从家具后面跑过。
abhishek-singh--wile-e-coyote-ar.exercise_en: Draw a path on the floor plane, have two cartoon characters chase each other along it, and place an occluder at the sofa so they disappear behind it. Twist: have students record the path by walking a loop around the room with a phone.

wonderscope-within--wonderscope.description_zh: 一款面向儿童的 iOS AR 故事应用：角色以真人大小出现在房间里，孩子通过四处走动、大声对角色念出台词来推动故事发展。
wonderscope-within--wonderscope.idea_en: A child reads lines aloud to move the story along, and AR characters answer right in the living room.
wonderscope-within--wonderscope.technique_zh: 通过平面检测把真人大小的角色放在地面上，语音识别将孩子念出的台词与剧本比对，以推进故事。
wonderscope-within--wonderscope.exercise_en: Make a three-line AR mini story with a character standing on the floor, where the plot continues only after the child reads the right line. Twist: when the line is wrong, the character gives a funny hint.

daito-manabe--discrete-figures.description_zh: 一场融合舞者、无人机、投影和机器学习“生成舞者”的舞蹈演出，这些生成舞者出现在表演者身旁，也出现在他们身上。
daito-manabe--discrete-figures.idea_en: Machine-learning-generated virtual dancers share the stage with real ones.
daito-manabe--discrete-figures.technique_zh: 舞者的动作捕捉数据用于训练或驱动机器学习生成的虚拟舞者，这些舞者被渲染进投影，映射到舞台元素和无人机上，而无人机的位置在同一空间中被追踪。
daito-manabe--discrete-figures.exercise_en: Record a classmate's dance skeleton data and generate a virtual partner in the projection that 'copies' them and gradually drifts off, sharing the stage with the real dancer. Twist: each round, the virtual partner generates from the previous round's deviations, and see how far it strays from the human.

ines-alpha--ines-alpha-x-katsu.description_zh: 与艺术家 Katsu 合作的人脸追踪 3D 妆容：带虹彩的雕塑形态随着面部动作从脸上生长出来，并紧贴面部。
ines-alpha--ines-alpha-x-katsu.idea_en: A 3D digital makeup look tailored to an artist, growing along with the face as it moves.
ines-alpha--ines-alpha-x-katsu.technique_zh: 在 Cinema 4D 中建模的雕塑网格被挂接到人脸追踪锚点上，并配有随视角变化的虹彩着色效果。
ines-alpha--ines-alpha-x-katsu.exercise_en: Make a small sculptural object in any 3D software and attach it to a face-tracking anchor (such as the forehead or a cheekbone). Twist: the object unfolds or folds up with facial expressions.
